Description: Center for International Environmental Law (CIEL) uses the power of law to protect the environment, promote human rights, and ensure a just and sustainable society. Out of its Berkeley office, CIEL supports the International Pollutants Elimination Network. IPEN is a global network of non-governmental organizations working to end the harmful production, use, and disposal of toxic chemicals internationally. CIEL rents suites 3 and 4 at 1962 University Ave.
